root_cause_criterion.description: After readRawData, the total bytes written to the pixel buffer must equal pixel_size. The vulnerable code discards the readRawData return value and never zero-fills the deficit, leaving bytes_written < pixel_size when the stream is exhausted. The fix captures the return value and memsets any deficit, ensuring bytes_written == pixel_size.

nodes.description: Uninitialized idx value (propagated from the uninitialized pixel buffer through the image heap buffer) is used in palette array indexing 3*idx+2, triggering MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.

edges.description: The pixel buffer with unchecked readRawData content is memcpy'd to the image heap buffer dst. The same pixel pointer is used in both the readRawData call and the memcpy source operand.

The uninitialized byte written to the image heap buffer (image) via memcpy at the RLE decode site is later loaded as uchar idx = *src++ in the palette conversion loop. Both operations reference the same image buffer.
